arguments.sql: SELECT u.gender, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE u.gender IN ('Male', 'Female') GROUP BY u.gender ORDER BY u.gender
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions by the gender of the card's owner, shown separately for male and female users.
assumptions: Each transaction is attributed to the user who owns its card (transactions -> cards -> users).
Counts include all transactions, labelled or not, since the question does not mention fraud.
